content:
“Good thing you installed shock absorbers.”

**Stabilized** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Big guns gain 30% accuracy. Double in Power Armor.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Big guns gain 30% accuracy. Double in Power Armor. | 00320163 | 

- This perk does not increase V.A.T.S. hit chance.
- Prior to the *C.A.M.P. Revamp* update, when firing a heavy gun, this perk increased the player character's accuracy and reduced a target's Damage Resistance and Energy Resistance.
